title: Kahana bar Yudan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman lists Rabbi Abba as his son, citing Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:14.

notes.text: Hyman calls Rabbi Abba the son of Kahana bar Yudan. The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:14 instead has Rabbi Abba bar Yudan (רבי אבא בר יודן), without Kahana in the patronymic. Hyman’s statement is retained, but this witness does not confirm that filiation.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 849) cites 4:14. Tamar Kadari’s transcriptions of the Constantinople first printing and Munich MS 50 read Abba bar Rabbi Yudan and Abba bar Yuda, respectively, in that passage. At 7:14 both give the fuller name Rabbi Abba bar Kahana bar Yudan. The fuller name is attested there, but it does not establish that the speaker at 4:14 was the same person.
